# Plain — Style Reference

> Warm ledger paper wired with forest-green circuitry, one signal lamp lit. Medium-weight Favorit headlines capped at 42px, a white and linen canvas, 1.5px stone rings for line work, and #1ad379 green spent only on dots and status pills.

**Theme:** light

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

Plain speaks a forest-ledger product language. A white #ffffff canvas carries the page, a warm #f7f5f3 linen panel is the secondary surface, translucent #e8e6e199 tiles sit inside product mockups, and two deep greens, #193227 and #0a2414, handle the inverted proof section and the announcement bar. The chromatic budget is one hue family in four working steps. #1b6646 fills every action, #1ad379 is rationed to status dots, the RSVP pill and the chat launcher, and #9af6bb lights text on dark green. No second hue enters the system. Type carries hierarchy at medium weight: ABC Favorit 500 stops at 42px with -1px tracking, about half the 72px-plus convention for SaaS heroes, while Geist Mono 13px uppercase handles buttons, links and captions. Shapes split between 100px pills for actions and 16px cards. Elevation is a 1.5px #e8e6e1 ring, not a drop shadow. The site reads as an instrument panel for a support team rather than a marketing billboard.

## Tokens — Colors

| Name | Value | Token | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paper Canvas | `#ffffff` | `--color-paper-canvas` | Page background, nav bar, human message cards and outline buttons (13 background uses) — the neutral stage the green ladder is measured against. |
| Linen Surface | `#f7f5f3` | `--color-linen-surface` | Sidekick demo panel, meta badges and recessed product areas (8 uses) — a warm off-white that separates zones without drawing a line. |
| Frosted Tile | `#e8e6e199` | `--color-frosted-tile` | Agent-authored message cards inside the thread mockup — 60% stone over white, so AI turns read as quieter than human turns. |
| Moss Panel | `#193227` | `--color-moss-panel` | Inverted customer-proof section and the closing CTA band behind white 38px headings — the deepest working surface. Do not use it for body cards on white. |
| Onyx Bar | `#0a2414` | `--color-onyx-bar` | Announcement bar background and nav link text (10 combined uses) — near-black with a green bias, so even the "black" belongs to the hue family. |
| Graphite Ink | `#252d2a` | `--color-graphite-ink` | Headlines, body copy, logo strip marks, card text (96 uses, the workhorse) — a green-gray charcoal that is softer than #000000. |
| Pewter Label | `#5a5851` | `--color-pewter-label` | Meta badge text such as "AI agent" and "You" (10 uses) — warm mid-gray for metadata that must stay legible at 14px. |
| Fog Caption | `#929694` | `--color-fog-caption` | Feature-column descriptions and secondary paragraphs (23 uses), flattened from #252d2a at 50% alpha — the second voice under every 18px title. |
| Ash Caption | `#9a9890` | `--color-ash-caption` | Geist Mono captions: "Trusted by thousands", testimonial names and titles, eyebrow tags (7 uses) — the quietest text step, reserved for uppercase mono. |
| Stone Ring | `#e8e6e1` | `--color-stone-ring` | Every ring shadow, the nav hairline, section dividers and card outlines (37+ shadow uses) — the system's only line color. Do not swap it for a cool gray. |
| Forest Action | `#1b6646` | `--color-forest-action` | Primary pill fill, outline button stroke and text, mono arrow links (15 uses) — the single action color, deep enough to pass contrast with white mono text. |
| Sprout Signal | `#1ad379` | `--color-sprout-signal` | Hero network nodes, RSVP pill, chat launcher, terminal cursor (2 fills) — the rationed lamp. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color. |
| Mint Glow | `#9af6bb` | `--color-mint-glow` | Stats, mono labels and highlights on Moss Panel (38 uses) — the light end of the ladder, valid only on dark green. Do not set it on white. |

## Tokens — Typography

### ABC Favorit — the display and UI voice, medium headlines over regular navigation and body · `--font-abc-favorit`

- **Substitute:** Hanken Grotesk at 500 for headings and 400 for body, Schibsted Grotesk at 500/400, Geist at 500/400. Favorit Regular draws slightly darker than Inter 400 at the same size, so do not drop the substitute to 300. Favorit Medium sits near a true 500 and should not be pushed to 600.
- **Weights:** 400, 500
- **Sizes:** 15px, 18px, 24px, 32px, 38px, 42px
- **Line height:** 20px, 28px, 30px, 32px, 36px, 44px, 46px
- **Letter spacing:** -0.15px at 15px; normal at 18px; -0.25px at 24px (400); -0.4px at 24px (500); -0.9px at 32px; -0.75px at 38px; -1px at 42px
- **OpenType features:** `"blwf"`, `"cv03"`, `"cv04"`, `"cv09"`, `"cv11"`
- **Role:** Medium 500 is the ceiling, and no bold appears anywhere in 114 Favorit uses. Hierarchy comes from size and negative tracking rather than stroke weight. The heading steps 32 → 38 → 42 climb at ratios of 1.19 and 1.1, which is compressed against a Perfect Fourth (1.333) convention, so the h1 is barely louder than an h2. The 32px h3 tracks tighter (-0.9px) than the 38px h2 (-0.75px), a deliberate inversion that makes card-level headings feel denser.

### Inter — the product-interface face inside mockups and thread UI · `--font-inter`

- **Substitute:** Inter itself is free. Otherwise use Geist at 400/500 or IBM Plex Sans at 400/500. Both draw within a hair of Inter's weight, and Plex reads slightly narrower.
- **Weights:** 400, 500, 600
- **Sizes:** 12px, 14px, 19px, 44px
- **Line height:** 16px, 20px, 26px, 28px, 40px, 54px
- **Letter spacing:** -0.095px at 14px and at 19px semibold; 0.44px at 44px; normal elsewhere
- **OpenType features:** `"ss01"`
- **Role:** Inter is quarantined to the rendered product (85 uses, mostly the 19px/28px thread copy) so that the mockups read as the real application rather than as marketing illustration. The 600 weight appears only on participant names inside threads, the one place bold is permitted. The 44px stat numeral is the only positive-tracked large size in the system (+0.44px), opened up for tabular legibility.

### Geist Mono — the micro-label for buttons, links, captions and tags · `--font-geist-mono`

- **Substitute:** Geist Mono is free. Otherwise use JetBrains Mono at 500 or IBM Plex Mono at 500. Plex Mono draws a touch lighter, so keep it at 500 and never drop to 400.
- **Weights:** 500
- **Sizes:** 13px
- **Line height:** 20px
- **Letter spacing:** 0.2px at 13px, always uppercase
- **OpenType features:** `"ss02"`, `"ss06"`
- **Role:** A single size and weight across 28 uses turns monospace into a typographic stamp. Every interactive label ("BOOK A DEMO", "SEE BROADCASTS →") is set in it, which is anti-convention: most B2B sites set CTAs in the body sans. The +0.2px tracking on uppercase mono gives the developer-console signal that matches the product's API-first positioning.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small | Inter | 500 | 12px | 1.333 | 0px | `--text-small` |
| caption | Geist Mono | 500 | 13px | 1.538 | 0.2px | `--text-caption` |
| body-sm | ABC Favorit | 400 | 15px | 1.333 | -0.15px | `--text-body-sm` |
| body | ABC Favorit | 400 | 18px | 1.556 | 0px | `--text-body` |
| body-lg | Inter | 400 | 19px | 1.474 | 0px | `--text-body-lg` |
| subheading | ABC Favorit | 500 | 24px | 1.25 | -0.4px | `--text-subheading` |
| heading-sm | ABC Favorit | 500 | 32px | 1.125 | -0.9px | `--text-heading-sm` |
| heading | ABC Favorit | 500 | 38px | 1.158 | -0.75px | `--text-heading` |
| heading-lg | ABC Favorit | 500 | 42px | 1.095 | -1px | `--text-heading-lg` |
| display | Inter | 500 | 44px | 1.227 | 0.44px | `--text-display` |

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Cap marketing headings at 42px in ABC Favorit 500 with -1px tracking — the restrained ceiling is the signature, so a 48px or 64px hero would read as a different brand.
- Spend #1ad379 only on dots, status pills, the terminal cursor and the chat launcher — rationed saturation lets one green dot carry the meaning "live".
- Set every button and deep link label in Geist Mono 13px 500 uppercase with 0.2px tracking — the console register is how the site signals an API-first product.
- Outline cards with a `0 0 0 1.5px #e8e6e1` ring instead of a `border` — rings do not affect layout and keep every surface at one elevation.
- Use #929694 for descriptions directly under #252d2a titles at the same 18px — two colors at one size are quieter than the conventional bold-title, small-gray-copy pair.
- Keep 100px pills for actions only and use 6px for tags and badges — this shape contrast is non-negotiable for telling clickable from informational at a glance.
- Place #9af6bb text only on #193227 or #0a2414 — the mint step exists to invert the ladder on dark ground.

### Don't

- Don't introduce a blue link color or a purple AI accent next to #1b6646 — the whole thesis is a single green hue family, and a second hue turns the ladder into a palette.
- Don't set headlines in Favorit 700 to add punch — bold strokes at 38px break the medium-weight hierarchy, which relies on size and -0.75px tracking alone.
- Don't use #1ad379 as the primary button fill — white 13px mono on that luminance fails contrast, and the lamp loses its scarcity.
- Don't add `0 8px 24px` drop shadows to marketing cards — depth shadows belong only to the floating mockup windows (`--shadow-lg`), and on cards they break the ring-based flat ledger.
- Don't replace #e8e6e1 rings with a cool gray such as a slate border — the warm stone matches #f7f5f3, and a blue-gray line would cool the paper.
- Don't render product mockups in ABC Favorit — Inter at 19px is what makes the thread UI read as the real application, not a marketing redraw.
- Don't make the navigation sticky with a blurred background — the 57px bar is static by design and is never frosted, keeping the page as uninterrupted reading space.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #ffffff (Paper Canvas)
- secondary surface: #f7f5f3 (Linen Surface)
- primary text: #252d2a (Graphite Ink)
- secondary text: #929694 (Fog Caption)
- line work: #e8e6e1 (Stone Ring)
- signal accent: #1ad379 (Sprout Signal)
- inverted surface: #193227 (Moss Panel)
- primary action: #1b6646 (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts use solid #1b6646 bars on #e8e6e1 tracks, secondary series as #1b6646 at 40% opacity, and #1ad379 only for a single highlighted point or live value, so the data never outshouts the 13px mono labels in #9a9890.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a primary action button: background #1b6646, text #ffffff, no border, border-radius 100px, padding 8px 16px, height 36px. Set the label "BOOK A DEMO" in Geist Mono 13px weight 500, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.2px, line-height 20px, with no shadow. Place an outline sibling 8px to its right with background #ffffff, 1px solid #1b6646 border, text #1b6646, the same radius, padding and type, labeled "TRY FOR FREE".

2. Build a navigation bar: full width, background #ffffff, height 57px, bottom border 1px solid #e8e6e1, position static, inner content constrained to 1200px. Put the Plain wordmark in #1b6646 on the left. Center five links ("Product", "Solutions", "Resources" each with a 10px chevron, then "Customers", "Pricing") in ABC Favorit 15px weight 400, color #0a2414, letter-spacing -0.15px, gap 24px. On the right, place an outline pill "SIGN IN" and a filled #1b6646 pill "BOOK A DEMO", both Geist Mono 13px 500 uppercase with 0.2px tracking, radius 100px, padding 8px 16px, 8px apart.

3. Build a hero section: background #ffffff, max-width 1200px, 96px top and bottom padding, two equal columns with a 64px gap. Left column, vertically centered: an h1 in ABC Favorit 42px weight 500, line-height 46px, letter-spacing -1px, color #252d2a, max-width 460px; then a 16px gap and a paragraph in ABC Favorit 18px 400, line-height 28px, color #252d2a; then a 24px gap and the primary/outline pill pair. Right column: an SVG radial diagram of about 80 dashed 1px #9a9890 spokes ending in 3px #9a9890 dots, with 12 spokes drawn solid in #1ad379 ending in 6px #1ad379 dots, converging on a 64px white circle with a `0 0 0 4px #e8e6e1` ring holding the logo mark in #1b6646.

4. Build a testimonial card: max-width 1200px, background #ffffff, box-shadow `0 0 0 1.5px #e8e6e1`, border-radius 8px, overflow hidden, two columns. Left: a 140px-wide green halftone portrait bleeding to the top, bottom and left edges. Right, padding 32px: a quote in ABC Favorit 24px weight 400, line-height 30px, color #252d2a; a 16px gap; a 20px-tall monochrome customer logo; an 8px gap; the name and title on two lines in Geist Mono 13px 500 uppercase, letter-spacing 0.2px, color #9a9890.

## Components

### Announcement Bar

**Role:** Event promotion above the navigation

A dark green ribbon. The bar uses an #0a2414 background, full width, a 40px height (estimated) and a centered row with a 10px gap. It holds an RSVP pill (#1ad379 fill, #0a2414 Geist Mono 13px 500 uppercase text, 100px radius, 2px 8px padding), an ABC Favorit 15px 400 message in #ffffff, and a trailing arrow. It is the only place where Sprout Signal sits next to the darkest surface, so treat it as punctuation rather than decoration.

### Navigation Bar

**Role:** Static top-level wayfinding and conversion

A flat white rail. The bar uses an #ffffff background, a 57px height, no shadow and a 1px #e8e6e1 bottom hairline, and it scrolls away with the page instead of sticking. The wordmark sits left in Forest Action. Five centered links (Product, Solutions, Resources with chevrons, then Customers, Pricing) are set in ABC Favorit 15px 400 #0a2414 with -0.15px tracking and a 24px gap. On the right, an outline Sign In pill and a filled Book a Demo pill sit 8px apart. Unlike the frosted sticky nav that is conventional in SaaS, this bar steps aside once the user starts reading.

### Pill Button — Forest (Primary)

**Role:** The single conversion action

The filled workhorse. The button uses an #1b6646 background, #ffffff text, no border, a 100px radius, 8px 16px padding and a 36px height. The label is Geist Mono 13px 500, uppercase, with 0.2px tracking and 20px line height, and there is no shadow. Use it once per viewport for "Book a demo". The mono label makes the CTA read as a command typed into a console rather than a shouted marketing button.

### Pill Button — Outline (Secondary)

**Role:** Low-commitment alternate action

A stroked twin. The button uses an #ffffff background, #1b6646 text, a 1px solid #1b6646 border (estimated), a 100px radius, 8px 16px padding and a 36px height. The label is Geist Mono 13px 500, uppercase, with 0.2px tracking. It always sits 8px to the right of the primary pill ("Try for free", "Sign in"). The pair shares one geometry and one hue and differs only in fill, so secondary means quieter, not different.

### Mono Arrow Link

**Role:** Inline navigation from feature to detail

Uppercase text with a trailing arrow. The link has no background, no border and no padding. It is set in #1b6646 Geist Mono 13px 500, uppercase, with 0.2px tracking, a 6px gap before the "→" glyph, and no underline. It sits 8px below a description paragraph. Use it for every "See broadcasts" or "See Sidekick agent" deep link. It acts as a button stripped of its pill, which keeps the 100px shape reserved for conversion.

### Eyebrow Tag

**Role:** Labels a product module section

A boxed mono stamp. The tag uses an #ffffff background, #9a9890 text, a 1px solid #9a9890 border (estimated), a 6px radius and 6px 8px padding. The label is Geist Mono 13px 500, uppercase, with 0.2px tracking. It sits 12px above a 32px heading such as "SIDEKICK AGENT". The 6px corner is deliberately sharper than the 100px pills, so a label can never be mistaken for a button.

### Feature Column

**Role:** Three-up capability summary

Containerless icon-title-copy stack. The column has no background, border or radius. It stacks a 40px dotted line-art icon in #2c9266 (decorative, not a system token), a title in ABC Favorit 18px 400 #252d2a, and a description in 18px #929694 at 28px line height, with an 8px gap. A Mono Arrow Link follows. Columns sit three across with a 32px gap, and the rows are separated by 64px. Same-size title and description keep the grid quiet: color, not size, separates the two voices.

### Testimonial Card

**Role:** Single customer quote with portrait

A hairline-ringed ledger entry. The card uses an #ffffff background, a `0 0 0 1.5px #e8e6e1` ring instead of a border, an 8px radius (estimated) and 32px padding on the text side. A green halftone portrait bleeds to the left edge. The quote is ABC Favorit 24px 400 #252d2a, followed by the customer logo, then the name and title in Geist Mono 13px #9a9890 uppercase. There is no shadow. The ring-only frame keeps a quote at the same elevation as running text.

### Thread Message Card (Main Content Card)

**Role:** Conversation turn inside product mockups

The product's native unit. Human turns use an #ffffff fill with a `0 0 0 1.5px #e8e6e1` ring. Agent turns use an #e8e6e199 fill with the ring at zero opacity. Both have a 16px radius, 12px 16px padding (estimated) and a 307px width. The author line is Inter 19px 600 #252d2a, the body is Inter 19px 400 at 28px line height, and Meta Badges sit inline. There are no drop shadows. The fill shift alone encodes "human versus agent", which is the site's argument rendered as a component.

### Meta Badge

**Role:** Author-type marker within threads

A compact warm chip. The badge uses an #f7f5f3 background, #5a5851 text, an `inset 0 0 0 1.5px #e8e6e1` ring, a 6px radius and 2px 8px padding. Text is Inter 14px 500 with -0.095px tracking and 20px line height. It marks "AI agent" or "You" beside a name. The inset ring keeps the chip flush with the card rather than floating, which reads as a data field, not a sticker.

### Label Chip

**Role:** Thread tags and assignee pills

A rounded white token. The chip uses an #ffffff background, #252d2a text, an `inset 0 0 0 1.5px #e8e6e1` ring, a 12px radius and 4px 12px 4px 8px padding (normalized), with a 14px leading icon or avatar. Text is Inter 19px 500 at 28px line height. It covers "Billing" or "Alex Kim" in the mockup sidebar. The 12px radius sits between the 6px badge and the 100px pill, a middle step reserved for removable or assignable objects.

### Logo Strip

**Role:** Customer social proof row

A monochrome roster. The strip has no container. A centered Geist Mono 13px uppercase caption in #9a9890 ("Trusted by thousands of B2B companies globally") sits above eight #252d2a wordmarks in an eight-column row spanning 1200px, with a 16px vertical gap. Each mark carries a small external-link arrow. The full-ink logos with no grayscale fade are a confident departure from the conventional 40%-opacity logo wall.

### Floating Chat Launcher

**Role:** Persistent support entry point

The system outlier. The launcher is a 48px square with a 100px radius, which renders as a circle. It has an #1ad379 fill, a #ffffff chat glyph and no shadow, and it is fixed 24px from the bottom-right corner. It is the only fixed element and the only large Sprout Signal fill. The exception is allowed because it is the product demonstrating itself: the brightest lamp marks the live support channel.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Cap marketing headings at 42px in ABC Favorit 500 with -1px tracking — the restrained ceiling is the signature, so a 48px or 64px hero would read as a different brand.
- Spend #1ad379 only on dots, status pills, the terminal cursor and the chat launcher — rationed saturation lets one green dot carry the meaning "live".
- Set every button and deep link label in Geist Mono 13px 500 uppercase with 0.2px tracking — the console register is how the site signals an API-first product.
- Outline cards with a `0 0 0 1.5px #e8e6e1` ring instead of a `border` — rings do not affect layout and keep every surface at one elevation.
- Use #929694 for descriptions directly under #252d2a titles at the same 18px — two colors at one size are quieter than the conventional bold-title, small-gray-copy pair.
- Keep 100px pills for actions only and use 6px for tags and badges — this shape contrast is non-negotiable for telling clickable from informational at a glance.
- Place #9af6bb text only on #193227 or #0a2414 — the mint step exists to invert the ladder on dark ground.

### Don't

- Don't introduce a blue link color or a purple AI accent next to #1b6646 — the whole thesis is a single green hue family, and a second hue turns the ladder into a palette.
- Don't set headlines in Favorit 700 to add punch — bold strokes at 38px break the medium-weight hierarchy, which relies on size and -0.75px tracking alone.
- Don't use #1ad379 as the primary button fill — white 13px mono on that luminance fails contrast, and the lamp loses its scarcity.
- Don't add `0 8px 24px` drop shadows to marketing cards — depth shadows belong only to the floating mockup windows (`--shadow-lg`), and on cards they break the ring-based flat ledger.
- Don't replace #e8e6e1 rings with a cool gray such as a slate border — the warm stone matches #f7f5f3, and a blue-gray line would cool the paper.
- Don't render product mockups in ABC Favorit — Inter at 19px is what makes the thread UI read as the real application, not a marketing redraw.
- Don't make the navigation sticky with a blurred background — the 57px bar is static by design and is never frosted, keeping the page as uninterrupted reading space.

## Surfaces

| Level | Name | Value | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Paper Canvas | `#ffffff` | Page background, nav, cards and human message turns |
| 1 | Linen Surface | `#f7f5f3` | Recessed demo panels and meta badges, a warm step down from paper |
| 2 | Frosted Tile | `#e8e6e199` | Agent message turns and translucent mockup tiles |
| 3 | Moss Panel | `#193227` | Inverted customer-proof and closing CTA sections |
| 4 | Onyx Bar | `#0a2414` | Announcement bar, the darkest and most inverted strip |

## Elevation

- **Mockup avatars, hero node halos (26 uses, the dominant ring):** `0 0 0 4px #e8e6e1`
- **Thread cards, testimonial card, outline frames:** `0 0 0 1.5px #e8e6e1`
- **Meta badges, label chips (flush rings):** `inset 0 0 0 1.5px #e8e6e1`
- **Inner image strokes and mockup inner frames:** `inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08)`
- **Large ring wells inside mockups:** `inset 0 0 0 4px #e8e6e1`
- **Floating product windows only (estimated):** `0 24px 48px rgba(37, 45, 42, 0.12)`

## Imagery

The page uses no lifestyle photography. The visual weight comes from rendered product mockups: a dark terminal window overlapping a light Plain app window, both with macOS traffic-light chrome and a soft `--shadow-lg` drop (the only real shadow in the system). Portraits appear as green halftone dot-screens bled into the left edge of the testimonial card, so a person becomes an engraving. Feature icons are dotted line-art in #2c9266, decorative and not a system token, drawn as stippled outlines rather than filled glyphs. The hero is a radial network diagram: dashed #9a9890 spokes converge on the logo, and a handful of solid #1ad379 lines and dots mark live connections. There are no gradients, orbs or glows. The narrative is many conversations converging on one calm, connected hub.

## Layout

Content sits in a 1200px frame, with 640px headline columns and 460px text columns inside it. Sections are separated by 96px and often by a full-bleed 1px #e8e6e1 rule. The hero is a two-column split: a 42px headline, an 18px paragraph and the two-pill CTA pair sit left, and the radial network diagram sits right. Sections alternate between centered 38px headings over wide mockups and left-aligned 32px headings with copy offset right, then flip to Moss Panel for proof. Features run three columns, the logo row runs eight, and the testimonial is a single full-width card. The 57px nav is static and filled #ffffff, with the logo left, links center and pills right. The footer is a multi-column link grid. At 375px, use the 32px heading-sm as display, a 64px section gap and single-column stacking. Density: comfortable.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #ffffff (Paper Canvas)
- secondary surface: #f7f5f3 (Linen Surface)
- primary text: #252d2a (Graphite Ink)
- secondary text: #929694 (Fog Caption)
- line work: #e8e6e1 (Stone Ring)
- signal accent: #1ad379 (Sprout Signal)
- inverted surface: #193227 (Moss Panel)
- primary action: #1b6646 (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts use solid #1b6646 bars on #e8e6e1 tracks, secondary series as #1b6646 at 40% opacity, and #1ad379 only for a single highlighted point or live value, so the data never outshouts the 13px mono labels in #9a9890.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a primary action button: background #1b6646, text #ffffff, no border, border-radius 100px, padding 8px 16px, height 36px. Set the label "BOOK A DEMO" in Geist Mono 13px weight 500, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.2px, line-height 20px, with no shadow. Place an outline sibling 8px to its right with background #ffffff, 1px solid #1b6646 border, text #1b6646, the same radius, padding and type, labeled "TRY FOR FREE".

2. Build a navigation bar: full width, background #ffffff, height 57px, bottom border 1px solid #e8e6e1, position static, inner content constrained to 1200px. Put the Plain wordmark in #1b6646 on the left. Center five links ("Product", "Solutions", "Resources" each with a 10px chevron, then "Customers", "Pricing") in ABC Favorit 15px weight 400, color #0a2414, letter-spacing -0.15px, gap 24px. On the right, place an outline pill "SIGN IN" and a filled #1b6646 pill "BOOK A DEMO", both Geist Mono 13px 500 uppercase with 0.2px tracking, radius 100px, padding 8px 16px, 8px apart.

3. Build a hero section: background #ffffff, max-width 1200px, 96px top and bottom padding, two equal columns with a 64px gap. Left column, vertically centered: an h1 in ABC Favorit 42px weight 500, line-height 46px, letter-spacing -1px, color #252d2a, max-width 460px; then a 16px gap and a paragraph in ABC Favorit 18px 400, line-height 28px, color #252d2a; then a 24px gap and the primary/outline pill pair. Right column: an SVG radial diagram of about 80 dashed 1px #9a9890 spokes ending in 3px #9a9890 dots, with 12 spokes drawn solid in #1ad379 ending in 6px #1ad379 dots, converging on a 64px white circle with a `0 0 0 4px #e8e6e1` ring holding the logo mark in #1b6646.

4. Build a testimonial card: max-width 1200px, background #ffffff, box-shadow `0 0 0 1.5px #e8e6e1`, border-radius 8px, overflow hidden, two columns. Left: a 140px-wide green halftone portrait bleeding to the top, bottom and left edges. Right, padding 32px: a quote in ABC Favorit 24px weight 400, line-height 30px, color #252d2a; a 16px gap; a 20px-tall monochrome customer logo; an 8px gap; the name and title on two lines in Geist Mono 13px 500 uppercase, letter-spacing 0.2px, color #9a9890.

## Green Ladder Discipline

Plain's palette is one hue walked from #0a2414 through #193227, #1b6646 and #1ad379 to #9af6bb, with warm neutrals (#252d2a, #5a5851, #9a9890, #e8e6e1, #f7f5f3) holding everything else. Each step has one job: dark steps are ground, the mid step is action, the bright step is signal, and the pale step is text on dark. The system breaks the moment a second hue appears. A blue link, an orange warning toast or a purple "AI" gradient would each make green a brand color instead of the whole language. To extend it, derive new states inside the ladder: an error state can borrow Graphite Ink with a #1ad379-free icon, and hover darkens #1b6646 toward #193227 rather than lightening it.

## Ring Line Work

Elevation at Plain is drawn, not cast. A `0 0 0 1.5px #e8e6e1` ring outlines thread cards and the testimonial, inset rings seat badges into their parent, and the 4px variant halos avatars and network nodes. Because box-shadow rings occupy no layout space, cards align on the 4px grid with no 1px border drift, a quiet advantage over conventional `border` outlines. This discipline is non-negotiable outside the mockup windows, the one exception that earns `--shadow-lg` because they depict real floating software. A blur-shadowed feature card would break it, and so would a ring in any color other than Stone Ring. To extend the system, add ring weight before adding blur: 1.5px for content, 4px for focus or emphasis.

## Display Ceiling

Plain caps its loudest marketing type at 42px Favorit 500, and h2s sit at 38px, only 1.1× below. Against the 64–96px hero convention, that is a refusal to shout: the headline carries the same voice as the product UI. Hierarchy is carried by tracking (-1px, -0.75px, -0.9px), by the mono/sans switch, and by whitespace of 96px between sections. A 72px hero would break it, as would bold 700 headings or a size jump above a 1.333 step anywhere in the heading ladder. To extend the system, add room instead of size: a new top-level moment gets more surrounding space and a Moss Panel ground, never a bigger font.

## Similar Brands

- **Plain** — Pylon shares the B2B support-platform category and the product-mockup-led storytelling, but spreads color across a multi-hue palette where Plain keeps a single green ladder.
- **Plain** — Attio shares the warm off-white canvas, hairline-ring card outlines and medium-weight grotesk headlines, with a cooler black-and-white accent strategy instead of green.
- **Plain** — Vercel shares the Geist Mono uppercase micro-labels and shadowless ring elevation, but runs a pure monochrome canvas with no brand hue at all.
- **Plain** — Front shares the shared-inbox subject matter and conversation-card mockups, with larger, more conventional hero type and a blue-purple accent.
- **Plain** — Linear shares the restrained medium-weight display type and console-grade precision, inverted onto a dark canvas where Plain stays light.
